name: RehabilitationClosureTracker
tagline: Progressive rehabilitation, completion criteria and closure cost in one Power Apps component
description: A complete mine rehabilitation and closure app for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: register of disturbed and rehabilitated areas by closure domain, a stage board from Disturbed to Signed off, completion-criteria monitoring (cover, species, erosion, monitoring interval), a closure cost estimate with unit rates and contingency, and independent sign-off.
features: 8 closure KPIs incl. progressive rehabilitation % and closure provision
Disturbed vs rehabilitated vs signed-off hectares by domain
Stage board with drag-and-drop and rule-checked transitions
Completion criteria: cover, species richness, erosion, monitoring interval
Record monitoring with live pass/fail preview
Independent sign-off and locked signed-off areas
Closure cost by domain with unit rates and contingency
Bulk stage moves, owner assignment, CSV export, undo
Demo mode with fictional sample areas
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
